detail.longDescription: Asked something AI cannot answer, and produces something anyway — because that's what it does. The only reliable cure is to supply a different default and make it easy to reach. The programming museum exhibit the fix, a prompt's real work, describing, in advance, an acceptable way to fail. Feedback appreciated ❤️ https://www. programmingmuseum.com/exhibit/ prompt-refusal # AI # LLM # Programming # Programmingmuseum # learning
